convoLines: "Can we talk?" Kenneth glances around first. "People are saying things. About you. Is any of it true?"
"I see." They take a moment to think about your answer.
"There's still the matter of the murder of Naran. Nobody's settled it."
Done — their story has a crack in it now.
The ground remembers.
No one saw Naran leave. Just trees.
You follow the food, the gifts, the sudden friendliness. Nothing you can prove — yet. Dig again; the trail is still warm.
The moot is called. The fire gets built up.
"Alright — I should get back to it."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."
"That's not naive. That's load-bearing. Hold onto it. No point pretending otherwise."
"Curry Leaf — crush the leaf, smell it, taste the stem. That's how you know it."
"I believe in breakfast. In people showing up. Small, provable things. The big beliefs all broke — the small ones held."
"Still on what you believe in."
"Yes. Absolutely. I've been hoping you'd ask." (A little too quickly.)
"Forget it — go on, I'm listening."
"Good question." I've led people before. Real people, real stakes. Watch me work and tell me I'm wrong.
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
"Someone asked me what we should do yesterday. I had an answer. That felt... right."
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Kenneth grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
"Power's a trap. Responsibility's a duty. I know the difference."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Sure. I'll be around."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
«No entiendo nada. ¡Nada!»
«Bien dicho. Exactamente.» They nod back, slowly. "Food?" — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
«No lo olvidaré.» A smile, tired but real.
«Eres un sol, gracias de corazón.» (you catch 'sol' — sun, 'corazón' — heart) You point at yourself, then at them, then at the fire. Together. They get it.
You hold still and let the sounds settle. «¿Tienes comida? ¿Algo?» (you catch 'comida' — food)
Catalina laughs — with you, mostly. "Good try! Again — Es verdad. Totalmente verdad." They walk you through it, patient as sunrise.
Something eases in their shoulders. They're really talking to you now.
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."

lines: d10: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Amy McDonald is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d10: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d10: 🕯️ Amy McDonald is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d10: What Amy kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d10: "Amy's gone." Kenneth looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Amy." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d10: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Jorge blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d10: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d10: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d10: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d10: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Amy McDonald, 10 days. The mantle passes to Jorge Keane.
d10: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Jorge Keane, 55 — a dry cleaner. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach.
d10: The village's quarrel was with Amy — and Amy is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d10: At the grave, Kenneth speaks for Jorge — "Amy trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d10: The fire knew Jorge before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
